name: rbx-forge
description: Desktop dev harness for Roblox projects built on the GenTree template
author: Acidgorgon

scripts.dist: node build/sdk-binaries.mjs && node build/rokit-binaries.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: node build/sdk-binaries.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64,x64 && node build/rokit-binaries.mjs --platform darwin --arch arm64,x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:win: node build/sdk-binaries.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64,arm64 && node build/rokit-binaries.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64,arm64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:dir: node build/sdk-binaries.mjs && node build/rokit-binaries.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --dir
